topic: Can MVDR beamforming sufficiently compensate for pattern degradation in array-fed reflectors during element failures?
response: MVDR beamforming can partially compensate for pattern degradation in array-fed reflectors during element failures, but not entirely. It reduces gain loss, especially in defocused reflector systems.
reference_context: Defocused reflector antennas are robust against feed failures, with MVDR beamforming mitigating gain loss, as shown in performance comparisons and beam pattern analyses.
